Subject: Complaint regarding the handling of order BW-076999

I am writing to raise a formal complaint about the way my recent order, reference BW-076999, was handled. The order contained a Cotton duvet cover, a Copper kettle and a Round wall mirror. It was placed about a month ago and was delivered a few days after dispatch.

I wish to make clear that I have no complaint about the products themselves. My concern is with the overall handling of the order, which fell short of what I have come to expect from your company.

Firstly, although I was informed that the order had been dispatched the day after I placed it, the tracking information was not updated at any point afterwards. I was therefore unable to plan to be at home, and I had no indication of when the parcel might arrive.

Secondly, the delivery was left on my doorstep without any notification and without a knock at the door. As the Round wall mirror is a fairly large and fragile item, I was rather concerned to find it sitting outside, where anyone could have taken it and where it was exposed to the weather.

Thirdly, the packaging was inconsistent. The duvet cover and kettle were packed together with a considerable amount of excess material, while the mirror recieved noticeably less protection than I would have thought appropriate for an item of that kind.

I would be grateful if you could look into these matters, pass my feedback on to the relevant team and your delivery partner, and let me know what steps will be taken to make sure future orders are handled with more care. I have been a satisfied customer in the past and would very much like to continue shopping with Brightwell Home.

Thank you for taking the time to consider my complaint. I look forward to your reponse.

Yours faithfully,

Samuel
